880-2692-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2692-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2829-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2829-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for {0} that dies on enter

1957-2530-4476--203.easyPrerequisites: You either have at least 2 life or {B} available.
1957-2530-4476--203.description:
Cast the creature card from your hand for {0}. The creature enters, then immediately dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the creature enters, Carnival of Souls and Answered Prayers trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls ability, adding {B} and losing 1 life.
Resolve the Answered Prayers ability, gaining at least 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

6871-6879-7298-8095.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

728-1981-2415-6772.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2021-2060-2445-4565.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

2946-4871-5075-6797.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5075-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-3263-6689-7790.description:
Cast Copy Catchers by paying {2}.
When Copy Catchers enters as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, Golbez's first ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Copy Catchers triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of it.
When the token Copy Catchers enters as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, Golbez's first ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Both Copy Catchers trigger. Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to pay.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Copy Catchers token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the remaining Copy Catchers trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of it.
Repeat from step 4.

969-3755-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
969-3755-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
969-3755-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7509.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2921-6972-7509.notes: If Gleeful Arsonist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1879-2539-3094-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
1879-2539-3094-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1869-3839-4050.description:
Cast Changeling Hero by paying {4}{W}.
Changeling Hero enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Inalla.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Changeling Hero with haste.
The token Changeling Hero enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Changeling Hero.
The nontoken Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, returning nothing from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Changeling Hero trigger from step 2, choosing not to exile anything.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Mistbind Clique token, adding at least one mana.
The Changeling Hero token leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Hero from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

240-413-5295-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

1069-1169-3552-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1169-3552-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7231.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two creature cards in all graveyards.
5256-6972-7231.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Drakestown Forgotten.
When Drakestown Forgotten dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3054-3416-5670-7173.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
3054-3416-5670-7173.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Virulent Emissary triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1308-1563-3499-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

176-560-5147.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-560-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

2511-2781-3817.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

57-283-955-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-955-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

373-877-4415.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {0}.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-2511-3269.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2511-3269.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2511-3269.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

1492-2866-4986-5147.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2866-4986-5147.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1385-1894-2173-5220.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1789-4875-5649-6797.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1825-3257-6760.notablePrerequisites:
Rakdos Carnarium and up to three other lands you control can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{W}.
Adagia has twelve or more charge counters on it.
1825-3257-6760.description:
Activate Rakdos Carnarium and up to three other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}.
Activate Adagia by paying {3}{W} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Treachery that is legendary attached to any creature.
If you control two legendary Treachery permanents, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Treachery token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, untapping Adagia, Rakdos Carnarium and up to three other lands.
Repeat.

1168-1651-4482-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-4482-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-4482-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Ancient Greenwarden, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

997-2732-6132.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3951-4192-5256-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Ashes of the Fallen on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
3951-4192-5256-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

1878-2634-5195-6108.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has four or more cards in hand.
1878-2634-5195-6108.description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Jeska's Will.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Jeska's Will copy, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
1878-2634-5195-6108.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of Jeska's Will's modes if desired.

222-527-969-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-969-5147.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

586-997-2350-5258-5618.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

215-4050-4683-4772-5176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
215-4050-4683-4772-5176.description:
Cast Sojourner's Companion by paying {0}.
Radagast triggers, creating two 3/3 Beast creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Beasts, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sojourner's Companion from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1494-1692-4802.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Sage of Hours.
Master Biomancer has power five or greater.
1494-1692-4802.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Sage of Hours with haste that enters the battlefield with at least five +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate the Sage of Hours copy by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

1335-2313-4929.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2313-4929.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marath.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
Once Cryptic Trilobite has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may remove them for infinite mana, then repeat step 1 to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Marath, which can then be used for Marath's other modes.

1312-3770-4050-5295.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gixian Puppeteer, adding {B}.
When Gixian Puppeteer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Gixian Puppeteer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2713-2775.description:
Activate Slimefoot by paying {2}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Slimefoot, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

739-937-3591.description:
During your upkeep, activate Necropotence by paying 1 life, exiling the top card of your library face down.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
